findings_addressed: Brief 1a site 1 (check-board-currency.sh:123) FIXED. The capture `Slice[-[:space:]]([0-9]+)` read `merge(0.8.20): Slice 39.5 ...` as slice 39. Because the walk is newest-first, the NEWER fractional merge set SEEN_SLICE[39] first and the genuinely-distinct `Slice 39` merge was then discarded by the superseded-intermediate branch at :125-128, so its SHA check never ran and the gate exited 0. Now `([0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)*)([^0-9]|$)`.

Brief 1a site 1, SECOND CONSEQUENCE (the :130-131 STALE diagnostic) FIXED. Pre-fix the gate printed a FABRICATED POINTER, measured verbatim against the unfixed tool: `STALE  0.8.95 Slice 39: landing commit 4f83dcd3 ("merge(0.8.95): Slice 39.5 - fixture fractional land")` - 39.5's SHA reported under the label `Slice 39`, misdirecting the reader to a unit that is not the one at fault. Post-fix it reads `Slice 39.5: landing commit 4f83dcd3`. Covered by a dedicated arm asserting BOTH the correct label and the ABSENCE of the truncated one, because the exit code is non-zero either way and therefore proves nothing here.

Brief 1a site 4 (preflight.sh:131) FIXED. The trailing `[^0-9]` matched the `.` in `Slice 39.5`, so one unit's CLOSED witness satisfied another's: `--expect-closed 39` was cleared by a plan in which only Slice 39.5 ever closed - in the gate whose entire stated purpose is catching a dependency that is not actually closed.
Brief 4 [DETERMINE] duty 1 (preflight.sh:131 interpolates ${EXPECT_CLOSED} unescaped into an ERE) DISCHARGED - see the `determinations` block below.

determinations.duty: Brief section 4 [DETERMINE] duty 1 - must ${EXPECT_CLOSED} be escaped?
determinations.determination: YES, escaping is REQUIRED - and it is NECESSARY BUT NOT SUFFICIENT. Escaping alone leaves site 4 open; tightening the trailing boundary alone leaves the wildcard open. Both are required, and they are independent defects, not one defect with two descriptions.
determinations.method: By EXECUTION, not by reasoning: a 16-case probe matrix (fractional-neighbour bleed x2, regex-wildcard bleed x2, true positives x7, integer/neighbour controls x5) run against FOUR candidate patterns via the real `grep -qiE` on real files. Script: scratchpad determine_ere.sh.

evidence.shipped_pattern: 4 of 16 diverge - BOTH defect classes live (`Slice 39.5 - CLOSED` satisfies ec=39; `Slice 39x5 - CLOSED` satisfies ec=39.5), on both alternatives
evidence.trailing_tighten_only_[^0-9]_to_[^0-9.]: 2 of 16 still diverge - the wildcard bleed SURVIVES, exactly as the brief warned. PLUS it introduces 1 NEW FALSE NEGATIVE: `CLOSED - Slice 39.` stops matching ec=39.
evidence.escape_only: 2 of 16 still diverge - the fractional bleed SURVIVES

determinations.implemented: esc_ere() escapes every ERE metacharacter via sed; the boundary is `([^0-9.]|\.[^0-9])`, NOT the obvious `[^0-9.]`, because the bare form causes the new false negative measured above and this gate's failure mode is REFUSING TO SPAWN. What must be rejected is a following digit, or a following `.`+digit (the start of a LONGER dotted id); a `.` followed by anything else is just punctuation. ERE has no lookahead, so it is spelled out.
determinations.asymmetry_of_the_two_alternatives_graded: Confirmed and handled. The first alternative ends `[^0-9]` and is followed by `.*CLOSED`, so it can never sit at end-of-line; the second ends `([^0-9]|$)` and can. The fix therefore gives the second alternative `(${ID_END}|\.?$)` - the extra `\.?` admits a legitimate sentence-final `CLOSED - Slice 39.` at EOL. BOTH alternatives have their own dedicated red-first arms (alt1/alt2) for BOTH defect classes: four recurrence arms, not two.

determinations.duty: Choice of trailing boundary in check-board-currency.sh (not a brief-assigned duty; a design call this leg had to make)
determinations.determination: Use `([^0-9]|$)`, deliberately keeping `.` INSIDE the permitted follower set, combined with a greedy `(\.[0-9]+)*` so a dotted id is always captured WHOLE.
determinations.method: By execution over a 10-subject table of merge subjects.
determinations.rationale: The stricter `([^0-9.]|$)` would make a degenerate subject INVISIBLE to the walk rather than merely mis-keyed. Invisibility is strictly worse here: the vacuous-pass guard at :143 only fires when a board matches ZERO lands, so one silently-dropped merge among several would restore exactly the silent hole this unit exists to close.
